pretreatments.description: Sodium hydroxide-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier grass, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier grass with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) NaOH as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Sulfuric acid-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier grass, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier grass with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) H2SO4 as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Sulfuric acid-catalyzed hydrothermal pretreatment of Napier grass, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier grass with distilled water and 1% (w/w) H2SO4 as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min (same heating process as organosolv), followed by washing with distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Auto-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier grass, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier grass with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing no added catalyst (auto-catalyzed), heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Auto-catalyzed hydrothermal pretreatment of Napier grass, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier grass with distilled water, heated at 190 °C for 60 min (same heating process as organosolv), followed by washing with distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Sodium hydroxide-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier silage, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier silage with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) NaOH as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Sulfuric acid-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier silage, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier silage with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) H2SO4 as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Auto-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment of Napier silage, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier silage with 100 mL of 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing no added catalyst (auto-catalyzed), heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH reached 7.0.

Auto-catalyzed hydrothermal pretreatment of Napier silage, involving mixing 10 g of dried Napier silage with distilled water, heated at 190 °C for 60 min (same heating process as organosolv), followed by washing with distilled water until pH reached 7.0.
Drying of Napier grass and Napier silage in a hot air oven at 60 °C overnight before chemical pretreatment.
